requiredBehavior: Typed input and every finalized voice transcript enter POST /executive/interactions.
Runtime classifies each interaction before conversation, presentation, or execution.
The provider remains silent until Runtime admits the finalized voice transcript.
Each completed user turn has one authoritative response_text rendered and narrated once.
Risk, confirmation, approval, and tenant context survive every transport.
Approval continuation preserves the exact interaction and returns through the same canonical endpoint.
A client presentation effect requires execution_scope client_presentation.
The Experience never upgrades a model response into operational fact or execution proof.

architectureProjection.systemSemantics: Cooperating constitutional responsibilities, not request-path tiers or deployment layers.

truthBoundary.experienceRole: Present Runtime-established state and collect user intent.
truthBoundary.runtimeRole: Establish operational truth, Authority, capability posture, execution, receipts, postconditions, and replay.
truthBoundary.demoData: Illustrative unless a Runtime response includes explicit evidence.
truthBoundary.providerKnowledge: model_native and never proof of current facts, organization facts, operational state, or capability.

integration.serverIdentityBinding: The Experience Gateway injects actor and context.workspace_id from authenticated or server-configured identity; browser identity fields are rejected.
integration.retiredRouteBehavior: Browser-facing retired interaction, free-form planning, and generic action routes return 410 canonical_interaction_required and identify /executive/interactions as the only coordinator.
integration.voiceSelection: Runtime owns the canonical full-duplex contract. This Experience artifact is explicitly continuity_only and cannot negotiate or claim that capability while quarantined.
